description: Election Commission - Declare that  K. U. P. Nishantha Dayal as a member of the Panadura P/S
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Panadura Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new elected member, which falls under the Elections category.
